name: Beth-horon

identification.note: Usually identified as the home of Sanballat "the Horonite" (Nehemiah 2:10), though some instead connect that epithet to Horonaim in Moab.

related_people.name: Sanballat
related_people.role: an official of Samaria from this town, who mocked and conspired against Nehemiah's rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls

description: A pair of towns (Upper and Lower Beth-horon) on the Ephraim-Benjamin border, along the pass where Joshua routed the five Amorite kings as the LORD made the sun stand still (Joshua 10:10-14). Nehemiah's opponent Sanballat "the Horonite" is usually identified as coming from here (Nehemiah 2:10, 19; 4:1-3).
